name: Kaiba Makoto
source:
The leader of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'trust' on his body.
The student council president, his hobby is drawing pictures.
A perfect guy, with smarts, great reflexes, and good looks.
A charismatic person who easily attracts people.
